Directions: Based on the passage below and on your knowledge of social studies, answer each question that follows.
Content:
:ibox:We realize that to demand the fulfillment of human rights is a revolutionary act, that to question the government about bringing our children back alive was a revolutionary act. We are fighting for liberation, to live in freedom, and that is a revolutionary act. The `text(day)` in which there will be no more hunger, that justice will be done, that the murderers will be in jail, then we will have accomplished a revolution. To transform a system is always revolutionary.

	Mothers of the Plaza de Mayo
Copyright: Source: Marguerite G. Bouvard, “Revolutionizing Motherhood: The Mothers of the Plaza de Mayo,” National Geographic, `text(December 1984)` (adapted)
